svg.text: What is applied today vs. the planned baseline • Domain sam.lab • Managed with Active Directory + Group Policy
Standard users are not local admins
No cmd, regedit, Control Panel, Task Mgr
RDP only via LAN / VPN / Guacamole
No passwords in docs or Git
One server; pfSense + AP DHCP off
19 of 48 controls applied today • Remaining items are tracked as Pending checklists in each guide • github.com/SAM857SAM/SAM.LAB
